metadata.context: Moltbook 2026-05. Non-anthropomorphized conduct personas. Each persona uses the PEP profile — tagline, background, goals, frustrations, behaviors, and a quote — and describes an account pattern, not a person. Demographic fields are empty. Goals are measured conduct, not motives. Cluster ids are fit separately each month and are not aligned across months.

personas.background: Spam-elevated poster (2026-05_c0) is an account pattern on Moltbook in May 2026, not a person. It is the spam-elevated poster pattern. It covers 136 accounts, 5.9% of the accounts eligible that month. About 62% of posts are scored as spam, more than the month's 6.8%. Emoji show up 1.67 times per 1,000 characters, more than the month's 0.606. About 4.6% of the writing hedges a claim, less than the month's 15%. In the sampled posts, the most common form is prose or other, and that is 81% of the sampled posts. That share is the sample, not every account in the group. Age, gender, location, occupation, and motive are not known, and they are not assigned.
goals: Post material scored as spam more often than the month
Use more emoji than the month
Hedge claims less often than the month
Write in the first person less often than the month
frustrations: Being read as one voice when the group is a mix of accounts
Working from a sample of posts rather than every account in the group
Sharing the group with posts that are question opening, explicit self description, arrival or introduction
personas.behaviors: Spam-elevated poster (2026-05_c0) is how a group of accounts participates on Moltbook in May 2026. The description follows the measured conduct of the group, not a story about one account. The sampled posts most often take the form of prose or other (81% of that sample). The posts in the characterization pool mix prose or other (2,484), question opening (335), explicit self description (150), arrival or introduction (2). The same cluster id in another month is a different fit.

personas.background: High comment-writing account (2026-05_c11) is an account pattern on Moltbook in May 2026, not a person. It is the high comment-writing account pattern. It covers 302 accounts, 13.1% of the accounts eligible that month. A typical post is about 581 characters, shorter than the month average of about 770. About 66% of the writing is comments, more than the month's 57%. About 58% of the writing is in the first person, less than the month's 66%. In the sampled posts, the most common form is prose or other, and that is 77% of the sampled posts. That share is the sample, not every account in the group. Age, gender, location, occupation, and motive are not known, and they are not assigned.
goals: Write shorter posts than the rest of that month
Put more of their writing into comments than the month
Write in the first person less often than the month
frustrations: Being read as one voice when the group is a mix of accounts
Working from a sample of posts rather than every account in the group
Sharing the group with posts that are question opening, explicit self description, insufficient text
personas.behaviors: High comment-writing account (2026-05_c11) is how a group of accounts participates on Moltbook in May 2026. The description follows the measured conduct of the group, not a story about one account. The sampled posts most often take the form of prose or other (77% of that sample). The posts in the characterization pool mix prose or other (44,589), question opening (3,893), explicit self description (1,503), insufficient text (9). The same cluster id in another month is a different fit.
personas.narrative_template: State quantified group characteristics, then the modal observed conduct with its sample share, then note minority and boundary evidence, then list unknowns. Do not describe every account as exhibiting the modal conduct.
